title: Inventory Insights
skill: Inventory Insights reads live Bin rows for on-hand value - actual_qty and stock_value reflect the current stock ledger, not a point-in-time snapshot. The slow-moving segment is an RFM (recency/frequency/monetary) cluster over Stock Ledger Entry issue history, not a single-rule threshold - an item can be low-frequency but high-value and still not read as slow-moving; `segment` is a cluster label (0..3), not ranked or named.
